in_marathi.name: Syam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Dawn
in_marathi.long_meaning: Syam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Syam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Syamala', which means 'God of Dawn'. In Hindu mythology, Syam is the name of the god Vishnu in his form as the sun god. He is also known as 'Ravi' and 'Surya'. Syam is a name that symbolizes new beginnings, hope, and the arrival of light in one's life.
